attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 2515020)
StrategyWiki: stub page only, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Final_Fantasy_XVI
Fandom (finalfantasy.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://finalfantasy.fandom.com/wiki/Final_Fantasy_XVI
notes: StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); Walkthrough, Gameplay and Achievements subpages are linked but not written (only a Table of Contents subpage exists). finalfantasy.fandom.com answers the API, with about 448 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "FAITH" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 2515020. 54 of 69 Steam achievements are hidden, so only 15 visible ones shape the side chapters; all hidden ones sit in the main story chapter. A group of about 14 hidden achievements near the end of the list share a similar unlock rate (roughly 15 to 20 percent) and may belong to the paid expansions, but the data does not say so; they were not split out and need checking.
